newsitem.title: USA: Former FBI Director Clarence Kelley dies at 85.
newsitem.headline: Former FBI Director Clarence Kelley dies at 85.

text.p: Former director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation Clarence Kelley died Tuesday in his home after a long illness, said Jeff Lanza, special agent with the FBI in Kansas City. Kelley was 85.
Kelley was director of the FBI from July 1973 to February 1978.
Before becoming director he was chief of police of Kansas City, Mo. He was an FBI agent from 1940 to 1961.
Kelley is survived by his wife, a son, a daughter and three grandchildren.
Funeral services will be held Friday at the Country Club Christian Church in Kansas City, Lanza said.
